name: app.R
content:
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)

variantes_relevantes <- read.table("variantes_rel", sep = "\t", header = T)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Strain Visualizer"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      # The checkbox group is always visible
      checkboxGroupInput(
        inputId = "impacts", 
        label = "Impacts to show:",
        choices = unique(variantes_relevantes$Impact), 
        selected = unique(variantes_relevantes$Impact)
      )
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      # Directly display the table without any tabs
      dataTableOutput("mytable1")
    )
  )
)



server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$mytable1 <- renderDataTable({
    
    req(input$impacts)
    
    variants_clean <- variantes_relevantes[variantes_relevantes$Impact %in% input$impacts, , drop = F]
    
    index <- grep("*_GT",colnames(variants_clean))
    var_tbl <- variants_clean[,c(7,index,6)]
    
    aa <- rbind(
      which(var_tbl =="1/1",arr.ind = T),
      which(var_tbl =="0/1",arr.ind = T)
    )
    
    strains <- colnames(var_tbl)[aa[,2]]
    geno <- as.vector(as.matrix(var_tbl)[aa])
    gene <- var_tbl[aa[,1],1]
    
    
    Descriptions <- read.table("Descriprions.tsv",sep = "\t",header = F)
    
      
    
    
    #edit final tbl
    cc <- cbind(
      gene,
      "strain" = strains,
      "genotype" = geno,
      "IMPACT" = var_tbl[aa[,1],167],
      "Description" = as.vector(Descriptions[2,match(var_tbl[,1],Descriptions[1,])])
      )
    
    cc
      
      
      
    })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
